subject: Is there a neat way to use isolate() for multiple lines of code?

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Is there a neat way to use isolate() for multiple lines of code?
parts:
Hi
 using the isolate() function in conjunction with actionButton, I want to apply it to a long set of code

It works if do it on individual lines e.g. 

change <- isolate(ceiling(input$obs/2))
 dist <- isolate(rnorm(change))

or 
isolate( change <- ceiling(input$obs/2))
 dist <- isolate(rnorm(change))

but when i try to wrap more than one line (which would be clearer) I get errors

messages.subject: Re: Is there a neat way to use isolate() for multiple lines of code?
parts:
You should be able to use:

isolate({
  change <- ceiling(input$obs/2)
  dist <- rnorm(change)
})
